legal.legal_subtitle: Legal information and terms of use

Third-party content:
Images, titles, synopses and other anime-related content belong to their respective owners and are used under the principle of fair use for informational purposes.

legal.privacy_subtitle: Your data is safe with us
legal.privacy_intro_after: , your privacy is our priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information when using our anime recommendation services.
legal.privacy_s01_body:
At Anikai, we collect information to improve your experience:

Information you provide:
• Registration data (username, email, password)
• Anime preferences and favorite genres
• Personal lists (Favorites, To Watch, Watched)
• Activity history on the platform
• Communications when you contact our team

Automatically collected information:
• Browsing and site usage data
• IP address and device type
• Cookies and similar technologies
• Content interaction metrics
legal.privacy_s02_body:
Your information is used exclusively to:

• Personalize anime recommendations based on your tastes
• Manage your account and personal lists
• Improve our catalog and curation system
• Send you notifications about new anime of interest
• Respond to your support inquiries
• Analyze site usage to optimize performance
• Prevent fraudulent activities

We do not share your personal information with third parties for commercial purposes.
legal.privacy_s03_body:
We process your data under the following legal bases:

Consent: By registering and using our services, you accept this policy.

Contract performance: We need certain data to provide the recommendations service.

Legitimate interest: To continuously improve our platform and protect it against abuse.

Legal obligations: When necessary to comply with applicable legislation.
legal.privacy_s04_body:
We use cookies and similar technologies for:

Essential cookies:
• Session authentication and security
• Display preferences
• Basic site functionality

Preference cookies:
• Your personal lists
• Language and theme settings

Analytical cookies:
• Anonymous usage statistics
• User experience improvement

You can configure your browser to reject cookies, though this may affect site functionality.
legal.privacy_s05_body:
We only share your information in the following circumstances:

Service providers: Hosting, data storage, analytics and email. All are contractually obligated to protect your data.

Legal obligations: When required by law or competent authorities, to protect our legal rights, or to prevent fraud.

With your consent: Only when you give us explicit permission.
legal.privacy_s06_body:
We implement technical and organizational security measures:

Technical protection:
• SSL/TLS encryption for all communications
• Secure password storage (bcrypt hash)
• Firewalls and intrusion detection systems
• Regular encrypted backups

Internal policies:
• Access restricted to authorized personnel only
• Periodic security audits

No system is 100% secure. We recommend using strong passwords.
legal.privacy_s07_body:
We retain your information:

While your account is active: Profile data, preferences, lists and history.

After deleting your account: We delete personal data within 30 days. We retain anonymized information for statistics.

Legal deadlines: Tax data for 5 years. Anonymized data indefinitely.
legal.privacy_s08_body:
You have the following rights over your data:

• Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate information
• Erasure: Request deletion of your data
• Portability: Receive your data in structured format
• Objection: Object to processing of your data
• Restriction: Request limitation of processing
• Withdraw consent: At any time

To exercise these rights: privacy@anikai.com
legal.privacy_s09_body:
Anikai is exclusively intended for users over 16 years of age.

We do not intentionally collect data from minors under 16. If we discover we have collected data from a minor, we will immediately delete the information and close the associated account.

Parents or guardians who believe their child has provided us with data should contact us immediately.
legal.privacy_s10_body:
Your data may be transferred and processed outside your country of residence to servers in the European Union and other countries, and international cloud service providers.

Guarantees: Approved standard contractual clauses and European Commission adequacy decisions.

By using Anikai, you accept these international transfers.
legal.privacy_s11_body:
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will publish the updated version on this page and indicate the update date. Significant changes will be notified by email.

Continued use of the site after changes implies acceptance. We recommend reviewing this page regularly.
legal.privacy_s12_body:
For privacy inquiries:

Email: privacy@anikai.com
Response time: 48-72 business hours

Right to complain:
• Spain: Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD)
• Mexico: National Transparency Institute (INAI)
• Argentina: Agency for Access to Public Information
